entries.en: Doctor, even an elcor could tell this crew is hiding something. Why don't you want me back there?
It was on my way.
You made it?
"Good job."
I can be pretty persuasive.
There's more than snow.
Are you hiding something?
Speaking of that back area...
Just take the cure.
Hang on.
Uhn...
I know you'd have a cure by now.
I'm sorry about this, Shepard. We've got orders from Benezia.
Open fire!
I am Alestia Iallis, from the University of Auräis. Is there anything in particular you want to know? Or should I just spout random facts?
I was meditating. I suppose to a species as brash as yours, it would appear to be inattention.
You are interrupting my meditations. Precisely how rude must I be to convince you to leave?
Recently transferred, yes.
Molecular genetics. I specialize in biotic-enhanced allele-specific hybridization.
I am very good at tracking inherited variations in genetic sequences. I am sure you would find it quite dull.
It's a genetic thing. Forget it.
That is one of the virtues of the meditation you interrupted.
Why ask me and not your friend?
Because I do not know anything about the Matriarch.
Then why would I?
Do you know President Huerta of Earth? I did not think so.
Then I will return to my meditations.
Did I interrupt something?
No need to be so rude.
You're a member of the science teams?
That's a bit technical for me.
You seem less upset at this situation than the others.
Do you know Matriarch Benezia?
Sorry, I'll leave.
Your work
Calm
My apologies.
Inconsiderate much?
What do you study?
That was over my head.
I saw her. You asked if I knew her. I do not.
Benezia passed through here. You didn't see her?
But she's here.
Think you could translate that into galactic?
Speak plain.
I didn't know Alliance basic training included biochemistry.
Got a smoke? We're all out.
Been counting your kills? I'm up to twenty-four.
Krogan. Hanar. These things. Doesn't matter what color they are, or how many legs they have. They're all out to screw us.
Welcome to hell. Smoking or non-smoking?
I just shoot things. You want a sitrep, you talk to Cap'n Ventralis.
The science crew look about to wet themselves.
You got a cure for rampaging bugs, Spectre?
Science pukes. Should just bug out and leave 'em to die. All their fault anyway.
Heh. "Bug out." Heh. Heh.
What the hell are you looking at? You want me to use this?
The company sent up a bunch of damn asari. Eye candy won't kill bugs.
Why'd you come up here? Some sort of death wish?
You think I'm afraid of you? Of them? Go talk to the captain. I'm watching you.
Blow your goddamn head off.
We're so dead.
No! Don't touch me!
I hope the others survive. I hope we all do.
Where did they come from? Were they in the lab? I never went in the high security areas.
My contract was up. I was going home.
They'll be coming for me. I know they will.
That Matriarch's dead. Everyone's dead over there. I tried to tell her, but she pressed down on my brains.
Why would you come here? We're all going to die.
You should go back down the mountain. While you can.
We're going to be eaten. Or freeze to death. Unless they bomb us from orbit.
You gonna find a cure for being eaten next?
You're not going to go to the hot labs, are you?
That stain in the corner is where Ellie died. I wanted to ask her out, but I never...
Look at the guard over there. Look at his hands. See them twitching?
If the bugs don't get us, one of Ventralis' people is going to flip out and kill us.
Why'd you come up here?
Ventralis has been awake for two days. Hard to believe he can walk straight.
We're dead. We just don't want to accept it.
No!
I can't talk about what happened. Not here. Too public.
Talk to Dr. Cohen down in the medical ward. He was the project lead.
I'm a toxicologist. I can't talk about my work. Not that I'm doing anything since the accident.
I can't say. I signed a non-disclosure agreement. If we survive, I'd like to keep my job.
The location is terrible, but the pay is better than any other commercial lab.
The outside world doesn't exist here. Just walls of ice and rock. There's only the work, the discovery.
It's easy to forget why science is guided by ethics. Maybe we're paying for that now.
Nothing. I didn't work there. As far as I know, Han Olar was the only survivor.
No, he's staying in the science team's quarters.
Be gentle with him. He had a trying experience.
It would be petty to complain after showering off a coworker's brain.
None of us have had enough sleep since the attack. Of course, not all of us have guns.
Asari? Well, there's Dr. Iallis over there.
Dr. Iallis is-- Well, she was right over there.
There's also our guest, Lady Benezia. Captain Ventralis might know where she is.
Remember to report any suspicious noises.
What! No!
Sorry. I haven't had much sleep since the attack. Is there something you need?
There was an accident here?
What sort of work do you do here?
You're not happy on Peak 15?
What do you know about the hot labs?
Is he in the medical ward?
I'm looking for an asari.
I'll talk to you later.
Accident?
This lab
The situation here
You don't like it here?
Where can I find him?
Get away from me!
The guards would shoot me to get you.
Nervously, I will keep my head down.
With trepidation, take your fighting elsewhere.
Relieved, it is pleasant to see you well.
Grimly, I will hope it is so.
Uncertain, I welcome you. Cautiously, I am curious to know what you're doing here.
Furtively, I am concerned about the state of our guards. Many have been awake for days.
Surprised, one has visited recently. Furtively, there are rumors she has gone to the hot lab.
Sympathetically, everyone here could say the same.
For now, with forced cheer, I still have a limited supply of equipment to sell.
Regretfully, most of my stock has been appropriated by Captain Ventralis.
With nervous amusement, I have nothing else to do. Why not continue to run my kiosk?
Pointedly, I give freely to Captain Ventralis. You, delicately, are not paid to protect us.
I'll see you later.
I heard there were some problems up here.
I was sent here to find an asari Matriarch.
It seems I've been caught up in events.
Let's have a look.
This doesn't seem like the time for commerce.
Given the situation, you should freely contribute to the defense.
I came to help.
You're running a store?
What's this "sell" crap?
Your mission ends here, Shepard.
What the hell?
I didn't have permission to come in. He got in my way.
You're not as stupid as you look.
You saw what you expected. Nothing more.
I was assigned to keep an eye on things here.
I was ordered to eliminate you, should the opportunity arise. And here you are, trapped in this lab.
Weapons free!
We'll see about that, bitch.
Ambush.
I thought she seemed odd.
You're a sleeper agent for Benezia.
What happened to Ventralis' man?
She's surrounded by geth and pointing a gun at us. Shoot her!
I thought you were a scientist.
You're the asari from the mess hall.
You work for the Matriarch.
